pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: DESCRIPTIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.2 Guided Writing: Neatness and Legibility (2 Sessions) • Handwriting •
Topic 3.4: Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you manage your time well?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply basic descriptive words in writing a simple paragraph
2. appreciate the skill of writing to express feeling and opinion

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: DESCRIPTIVE WRITING
This lesson teaches Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing for Grade 8 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. apply basic descriptive words in writing a simple paragraph
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the skill of writing to express feeling and opinion
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing above.
2. Explain Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you manage your time well?
2. Why do we organise ideas in a paragraph?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. apply basic descriptive words in writing a simple paragraph
2. appreciate the skill of writing to express feeling and opinion

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
